chapter.verse: Pasian in eima belh leh i thahatna hi a, haksat hunin hong huh pahpahpa ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, leitung kikhin-in, mualte tuipi sung a kiden’na zongin, a tuite ging zuazua-in phuan zuazua a, hih gin’na hangin mual liante a liing zongin, i lau kei ding hi.
Sang Penpa’ ten’na khua siangtho ahi, Pasian’ khuapi, a lungdamsak gun khat a om hi.
Ama laizangah Pasian om a, amah a kiliing kei ding hi; Pasian in phalvak tungin amah huh ding hi.
Minamte heh mahmah uh a, kumpi gam kiliing hi; ama aw ging khiasak a, leitung kicimgawp hi.
Mi honte’ Topa ei tawh hong omkhawm a, Jakob’ Pasian in eima belh ahi hi.
Hong pai un la, Topa ’ sepna, leitung, gamkhing a suahsak khitna hong en un.
Amah in leimong dong ah gal beisak hi; amah in thalpi kuaitanin, teipi susia a, leengte mei tawh haltum hi.
“Om hit-hiat un la, Pasian ka hihna thei un. Minamte lakah keimah hong kisangsak a, leitungah ka min hong kithangsak hi!”
Mi honte’ Topa in ei tawh omkhawm a, Jakob' Pasian in eima belh ahi hi.
